name: Chives

companions.note: Deters aphids and soft-bodied pests from brassicas
Same pest deterrence as with kale

pnw_notes: Perennial — plant once and it returns each year. Purple globe flowers in May–June are edible and excellent for pollinators. Goes dormant in winter. Divide clumps every 2–3 years. NOT safe for Jazzy or cats — allium family.

frost_hardiness.notes: Perennial — goes fully dormant in winter and returns in spring without any intervention.

planting_windows.notes: Start indoors for transplanting; or divide an existing clump for instant results
Direct sow in spring; slow to establish from seed first year
Snip leaves 2 in above soil; harvest purple flowers May–June before they fade
